gen-dafont-college-gf-montagu-slab: College draws every curve as hefty as its straight stems, giving headlines a cut-from-one-ribbon punch. But Montagu Slab is the one to read, with mild contrast and a sizable x-height built for screens.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-serif-hentaig: Chunky and skimming: College never changes its stroke weight, while Noto Serif Hentaigana lightens its diagonals just slightly. Across lengthy text, its subtle modulation keeps the eye gently moving.
gen-dafont-college-gf-ovo: Soft contrast in every curve makes this classic serif read gently, its thins barely lighter than its thicks. Ovo takes over from College's toothpaste-steady heading line with soft curves, so the page shouts once and then settles.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-domine: Geometric and unshaded, Conthrax keeps every stroke uniform, a smooth wire running through each word. Domine, a dignified serif, adds compact ascenders and a slight pinch where curves meet stems.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-esteban: Conthrax has a smooth drawn-wire feel across the whole line, every stroke geometric and clean. But Esteban lets its thin strokes run only slightly lighter than the thick ones, and its e never squeezes shut.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-faustina: Faustina reads classic and authoritative, its bowls thinning gracefully rather than sharply. And through pages of text it keeps its footing, a gentle foil to Conthrax's constant, unshaded strokes.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-halant: Halant reads sturdy and traditional, with a faint thick-thin shift. Beside Conthrax, whose pen never changes pressure or angle, this text serif brings gentle modulation that keeps paragraphs comfortable.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-hedvig-letters-se: Geometric and clean, Conthrax has a thickness like neon glass tubing. Hedvig Letters Serif, sturdy in the lowercase with medium contrast, carries text onward with curves that have room to breathe.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-lisu-bosa: Clean and geometric, Conthrax gives its diagonals as much heft as its stems. Lisu Bosa, a serif, lets sturdy lowercase and open counters carry text with a moderate stem-to-hairline ratio that never feels stiff.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-marcellus-sc: Conthrax keeps every letter free of stroke variation, geometric and clean from a to z. But Marcellus SC, a serif, adds the restrained swell of a barely pressed round brush, the pairing's best trait.
